page.layout: One printed page, single text column. Running head at top centre. Headings at left, verse lines indented beneath them. A marginal note at the right, lower part of the page, beside the verse of heading 13.

main_text.l: 12. Ievis vn iour le Monde combatant, &c.
Secura si quis spe vagus ocia-

page.notes: Marginal word "Nixus" printed at the lower right, beside the last verse of section 13; placed as a note. Doubtful readings: "lnce" (likely "luce"), "conferit", "Vltro", "tecta", "perurit" and "caca" are copied as printed; "Virtus relictis, credite, iurgijs" and the verse of section 11 contain non-standard letterforms (long s and f-like shapes) read as printed. Long s rendered as plain s. The headings "11.", "12.", "13." are printed numbered titles and are kept as level 2 headings, not divisions. Several verse lines have a printed reverse-hook or ligature at the start of a word, read as printed where legible. Lines of section 12 and 13 are verse and kept as printed line breaks.
